preconditions.description: The number of provinces P must be between 1 and 15.
The number of columns N in each province must be between 1 and 600.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for S in provinces)
preconditions.description: Each string S representing the rows of a province must have a length equal to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct strings formed by the knight for each province.
